review_candidates.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Security Operations team is responsible for designing, building, and operating a world-class Security Operations Center, and the successful candidate will provide leadership, mentorship, expertise, and outstanding individual contributions towards those ends. Site reliability engineering - deploying, maintaining, and automating security tools.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The Security Operations team is responsible for designing, building, and operating a world-class Security Operations Center, and the successful candidate will provide leadership, mentorship, expertise, and outstanding individual contributions towards those ends. 10+ years of relevant professional experience Professional cybersecurity experience, preferably working or leading a Security Operations Center. Proficiency in common scripting languages, such as Python and Bash. Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability. Proficiency in additional programming languages, such as Golang.
